prompt:
P3 Reload inspired economical graphic anime portrait. One chromatic THEME family + near-black + neutral white. Skin is flat neutral white. Eyes use decisive upper lid and flat iris, nose a minimal shape distinctive to face, mouth a purposeful mark or open graphic silhouette; no lip realism, small texture or detailed ear anatomy. Hands read through overlap and silhouettes, no nails, tendons or knuckles. Hair uses coherent masses and few large locks. Clothing two or three large hard-edged shadow planes. Preserve age, body and face geometry without turning every person into an idealized same-face protagonist.
BACKGROUND: bright MAIN THEME field plus ONE or TWO broad deeper SAME-HUE graphic regions, about 15-30% of background area. Pick sweeping arc, diagonal cut, wide edge band or off-center curve to support the character gesture and negative space. The deeper region must still visibly read as the theme hue, NEVER near-black. No gradient, glow, grain, texture, tiny pattern, text, logo, typography, particles or transparency. Not a completely single-value solid background. Not the same exact arc placement in every image. The background is fully opaque to all four image edges.
Square source for circular avatar. Eyes, nose, mouth, chin and dominant hair silhouette inside centered circle. Head height roughly 50-65% of canvas; no full body, no distant tiny head, no drawn circle border. Vary head and shoulders, expressive gestures and camera in the safe circle. No routine white forelock or eye-corner beauty mark. Color does not count as a different identity. Render the requested actual facial structure, expression and posture clearly, not merely different labels.

INDIVIDUAL: 80-year-old man, short neck and compact sturdy shoulders. FACIAL GEOMETRY: narrow forehead widening to a heavy angular jaw; wide-set round eyes, separated thick rising brows, short upturned nose silhouette, broad mouth with unequal corners. Keep facial proportions distinctly recognizable through silhouette and few marks. Clearly older adult: jowls, eyelid weight, cheek structure and posture; just a few purposeful age lines, no youthful model face.
HAIR SILHOUETTE: one near-black mass, long bowl cut covering ears. Do not add white forelock except an entirely white hairstyle if explicitly requested. No glasses.
FACIAL EXPRESSION: delight: eyes squeezed pleasantly, high cheeks; mouth closed in a short off-center line appropriate to emotion. Mouth/eyes/brows visibly differ from a generic polite smile.
GESTURE: upper edges of folded arms at lower crop; chin lifted with throat silhouette visible. CAMERA: three-quarter-left, high-angle; nose points at LEFT IMAGE EDGE, visible ear on IMAGE RIGHT.  Camera visibly above eye level: crown plane visible, eyes look up, chin foreshortened. The camera orientation takes priority if a gesture description conflicts. Adapt pose into head-and-upper-chest crop, never full figure.
WARDROBE: wide soft pullover, broad open collar showing plain crew-neck inner layer. One broad readable garment silhouette, no little details.
PALETTE: main #EF3340; deeper #A71927; near-black #09121B; neutral white #FAFBFC. No colors outside this family. BACKGROUND: bright main #EF3340 plus large sweeping lower arc in deeper #A71927, approximately 20% of background, no black background and not completely flat single-value background.
Make this one ORIGINAL standalone character distinct from previously generated portraits in face, expression, silhouette and clothing. Do not copy an existing character or use a stock handsome anime face. One clean finished FULL-BLEED SQUARE portrait: theme field reaches all four corners, NEVER a baked circular mask. All facial landmarks and entire hair/headwear fit inside central x=20–80%, y=14–76% region. Render a modest head size to fit. No routine scarf unless specifically requested.
SPECIFIC IDENTITY REFINEMENT (overrides earlier conflicting details): Very old stocky person with short full neck, large ears, flat bowl silhouette and wispy TWO-point beard as clean simple graphic marks. Closed calm smile with broad sagging jowls.
